name: Moom
description: Moom is a macOS window manager for moving and resizing windows, restoring saved layouts and running custom window actions across apps and displays.
agentUseSummary: Moom is visible as a supported AppleScript security preview. Relay will not invoke mutable name-selected layouts or custom actions until a Mac-local bridge can bind an inspectable target and constrain Moom's Accessibility authority.

capabilities.label: Automate approved window layouts
capabilities.description: After local bridge hardening, list layouts or perform a narrowly approved window operation on the connected Mac using Moom's supported AppleScript dictionary.

blocked.label: Control Moom from Railway
blocked.description: Moom's supported automation and window state are local to a Mac; Relay will not export Accessibility authority to Railway.

blocked.label: Trust a layout or action name
blocked.description: Moom resolves duplicate AppleScript names to the first match and named content can change, so a name alone is not an immutable authority boundary.

blocked.label: Create, merge or replace a saved layout
blocked.description: Moom's AppleScript write commands capture current cross-application window state and mutate saved automation definitions.

blocked.label: Apply an unreviewed layout or custom action
blocked.description: A Moom layout can move windows across apps, raise or hide apps, and optionally launch apps whose document restoration is controlled outside Relay.

blocked.label: Run actions before local bridge hardening
blocked.description: No list, center, run, apply, save, merge or replace action is callable until a local bridge enforces target identity, effect bounds, approval, auditing, drift and revocation.

approvalProfiles.label: Local bridge review required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and execution remain unavailable until Relay can constrain Moom's supported AppleScript commands and bind approved window automation without trusting mutable names.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tool is callable until a hardened Mac-local bridge safely wraps Moom's supported AppleScript interface.
No Hermes tool is callable until a hardened Mac-local bridge safely wraps Moom's supported AppleScript interface.

providerSetup.blocker: Moom's supported AppleScript dictionary selects layouts and custom actions by mutable, potentially duplicate names and cannot expose immutable content for Relay approval; execution uses broad macOS Accessibility authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Design a Mac-local adapter that starts with bounded read-only listing and centering, requires unique target names, obtains inspectable stable identifiers or provider support before layout/action execution, separates layout writes, records approvals locally, audits every effect and revokes on drift.

evidence.supports: Many Tricks documents AppleScript commands to list, run, apply, create, merge and replace layouts and custom actions, and warns that duplicate names resolve to the first match.
Many Tricks documents app-specific and any-window layouts, optional app launching, document restoration, cross-app window capture and automatic layout triggers.
Moom's official setup guide requires macOS Accessibility permission for window control.
Current release notes confirm maintained AppleScript action listing and layout execution that can launch apps and open restored documents.
